passages.text: Harbor Lane Bakery opened on 14 March 2019 in the town of Velmora. Its signature product is the cinnamon lattice loaf, sold for 6 euros.
The Orion relay station orbits Ceres at 412 kilometres. Its maintenance crew rotates every 45 days, and the station reports to the Lunar Ops Desk.
Policy HR-7: employees accrue 1.75 vacation days per month. Unused days roll over for at most 9 months.
The Kestrel water filter removes lead at 99.2 percent efficiency and needs its cartridge replaced every 3 months.
